Authentication failed: copy the complete: Authentication failed: copy the complete key again, remove extra whitespace, and check its active status and expiry. Custom keys do not necessarily begin with sk-.

For support, include the time, model, re: For support, include the time, model, request ID if supplied, and error status. Never send your API key, session cookie, or password. Error details vary by endpoint; use the returned status and message rather than assuming one universal error shape.
If a request is interrupted or times out: If a request is interrupted or times out, check Usage before repeating it. A retry is a separate request and can incur another charge.
Instructions for the current customer co: Instructions for the current customer console and integrations. Verify model access and protocol support with your account before relying on a workflow.
Model unavailable or access denied: veri: Model unavailable or access denied: verify the selected key’s group and available model list. Check IP restrictions and provider route availability.

Quota or balance exhausted: inspect the: Quota or balance exhausted: inspect the key’s quota and rolling USD limits, then the account balance or subscription usage. Changing a key quota does not fund the account.
